scope.zh: 车载旅途影像捕捉与保存；安全门控、任意目标与自动配文另核
scope.en: Vehicle-based scenic capture and storage; safety gating, arbitrary targeting and captions require separate verification.

cn.note: 车载旅途拍摄已有少量量产应用；驾驶状态门控、目标理解与配文仍未核实为完整闭环。
cn.noteEn: Scenic capture has limited production use; safety gating, intent interpretation and captioning are not verified as a full workflow.

global.note: 车载旅途拍摄已有少量量产应用；驾驶状态门控、目标理解与配文仍未核实为完整闭环。

scope.zh: 非接触生命体/运动感知与提醒、温控等部分关怀；不把诊断和连续生理分析算作已实现
scope.en: Non-contact presence/motion sensing with alerts or climate care; diagnosis and continuous physiology analysis are not inferred.

cn.note: 中外已有非接触生命体/运动感知与提醒、温控等局部关怀；连续生理分析仍需单独核查。
cn.noteEn: Non-contact presence/motion sensing, alerts and limited climate care exist; continuous physiology analysis is not established.

global.note: 中外已有非接触生命体/运动感知与提醒、温控等局部关怀；连续生理分析仍需单独核查。
global.noteEn: Non-contact presence/motion sensing, alerts and limited climate care exist; continuous physiology analysis is not established.

scope.zh: 体压/状态反馈驱动的按摩适配；固定按摩、定时姿态调节仅算相关能力
scope.en: Pressure/state-feedback adaptive massage; fixed massage and scheduled posture changes are related capabilities only.

cn.note: 普通按摩已在多品牌提供，但本场景要求体压与状态驱动的自适应，核查中只找到相关能力。
cn.noteEn: Massage is offered by multiple brands, but this scenario requires pressure/state-driven adaptation; only related capabilities were verified.

global.note: 普通按摩已在多品牌提供，但本场景要求体压与状态驱动的自适应，核查中只找到相关能力。
global.noteEn: Massage is offered by multiple brands, but this scenario requires pressure/state-driven adaptation; only related capabilities were verified.

scope.zh: 声音随内容或舱内声学条件适配；逐歌曲与跨车偏好迁移另核
scope.en: Audio adaptation to content or cabin acoustics; per-song and cross-car preferences require separate verification.

cn.note: 音频内容处理、噪声补偿和个人调音已有应用或供应商方案；逐歌曲与跨车辆偏好迁移未核实。
cn.noteEn: Content processing, noise compensation and personalization exist; per-song and cross-vehicle preference transfer remain unverified.

global.note: 音频内容处理、噪声补偿和个人调音已有应用或供应商方案；逐歌曲与跨车辆偏好迁移未核实。
global.noteEn: Content processing, noise compensation and personalization exist; per-song and cross-vehicle preference transfer remain unverified.

scope.zh: 调光天幕作为投影面及观看联动；普通影院屏/幕布不计入
scope.en: Dimmable roof as projection surface with viewing coordination; conventional cinema screens are excluded.

cn.note: 舱内影院已有量产车型，现有证据是专用幕布或折叠显示屏；未找到调光天幕直接投影的量产证据。
cn.noteEn: Cabin cinema exists with dedicated screens or folding displays; dimmable-roof projection was not verified in production.

global.note: 舱内影院已有量产车型，现有证据是专用幕布或折叠显示屏；未找到调光天幕直接投影的量产证据。
global.noteEn: Cabin cinema exists with dedicated screens or folding displays; dimmable-roof projection was not verified in production.

scope.zh: 停驻时按乘员请求以受限机械臂取放轻小物品；工厂机器人不计入
scope.en: Parked occupant-requested lightweight object handling by bounded cabin arm; factory robots are excluded.

cn.note: 按停驻、轻小物品取放、乘员指定与受限抓取机制检索，未找到中外量产乘用车型官方证据。工厂机械臂与车外机器人不计入；专利单独展示。
cn.noteEn: Search for parked, occupant-requested lightweight object handling found no official production passenger-car evidence. Factory and external robots are excluded; patents are shown separately.

global.note: 按停驻、轻小物品取放、乘员指定与受限抓取机制检索，未找到中外量产乘用车型官方证据。工厂机械臂与车外机器人不计入；专利单独展示。

scope.en: Unresponsive-driver warning and dedicated controlled stop; basic fatigue warnings, AEB and manual stops are excluded.

cn.note: 计数对象为无回应提醒衔接受控停车：海外已有多集团应用，中国本次核实小鹏X9；普通DMS/AEB不计入。
cn.noteEn: The counted mechanism is unresponsive-driver warning followed by controlled stop: multiple overseas groups and XPENG X9 in China are verified. Generic DMS/AEB are excluded.

scope.zh: 同一屏跨座舱与营地的机械位置迁移；固定后排屏与外部投影不计入

cn.note: 现有量产证据包括舱内折叠屏与车外投影；未找到同一柔性屏跨前后排、尾门与营地移动的量产证据。
cn.noteEn: Existing products include interior folding screens and exterior projection; a flexible screen repositioned across cabin/tailgate/campsite is unverified.

de.note: 本次围绕德国核查。德国电车站点结构不同，不能把所有停靠都解释为乘客会跨越车道。 法规和服务证明任务背景，不证明OEM已实现完整AI流程；车型、年份与配置需逐条核对。
de.noteEn: This review targets Germany. German tram stops differ; not every stop implies passengers crossing a vehicle lane. Rules and services establish context, not a complete OEM AI workflow; model years and trims remain explicit.

cn.note: 本次新增场景以德国为目标市场，未开展中国市场的穷尽核查。

global.noteEn: Verified German applications are shown under Germany; no prevalence conclusion is made for other overseas markets.

scope.zh: 区域标牌、儿童、球、遮挡车辆与可见变化相关的核心任务实现；通用导航、提醒、法规页面及手机服务不计入OEM应用
scope.en: Core implementation involving area signs, children, balls, parked occluders and visible changes; generic navigation, reminders, legal pages and mobile services are excluded from OEM adoption.

de.note: 本次围绕德国核查。德国交通缓和区域允许儿童活动，行人使用空间与普通道路不同。 法规和服务证明任务背景，不证明OEM已实现完整AI流程；车型、年份与配置需逐条核对。
de.noteEn: This review targets Germany. German traffic-calmed areas allow child activity and differ from ordinary road space. Rules and services establish context, not a complete OEM AI workflow; model years and trims remain explicit.

scope.zh: 大型动物识别提醒；连续穿越预判另核，历史车型不计入当前应用数量
scope.en: Large-animal detection/warnings; sequential crossing inference requires verification, and historical models are excluded from current adoption counts.

de.note: 大型动物识别提醒已核实保时捷Taycan的部分核心实现。宝马2013年车型作为历史先例单列，不计入当前应用数量；连续穿越预判未核实。
de.noteEn: Porsche Taycan verifies partial large-animal detection/warnings. BMW 2013 models are listed as historical precedents, excluded from current counts; sequential crossing inference is unverified.

scope.en: Core implementation involving bike carrier, repeat plate, lights and exposed straps; generic navigation, reminders, legal pages and mobile services are excluded from OEM adoption.

de.note: 本次围绕德国核查。德国自行车运输需注意号牌和照明遮挡；图像只支持可见项核验。 法规和服务证明任务背景，不证明OEM已实现完整AI流程；车型、年份与配置需逐条核对。
de.noteEn: This review targets Germany. German bicycle transport requires attention to plate/light visibility; images cover only visible checks. Rules and services establish context, not a complete OEM AI workflow; model years and trims remain explicit.

scope.en: Core implementation involving clearance signs, barriers and confirmed roof-load state; generic navigation, reminders, legal pages and mobile services are excluded from OEM adoption.

de.note: 奔驰提供按输入尺寸规划路线的相关能力；车顶载物视觉测量和现场净空确认没有由此得到证明，不计入核心应用数量。
de.noteEn: Mercedes-Benz documents dimension-aware routing, a related capability. This does not verify visual roof-load measurement or on-site clearance assessment, so it is excluded from core adoption counts.

scope.zh: 设备型号、上下层、限高限重与操作状态相关的核心任务实现；通用导航、提醒、法规页面及手机服务不计入OEM应用
scope.en: Core implementation involving lift model, level, height/load ratings and operating state; generic navigation, reminders, legal pages and mobile services are excluded from OEM adoption.

de.note: 本次围绕德国核查。德国厂商提供双层机械停车设备，其限制随型号与层位不同，不以品牌名称推断适配。 法规和服务证明任务背景，不证明OEM已实现完整AI流程；车型、年份与配置需逐条核对。
de.noteEn: This review targets Germany. German suppliers provide two-level parking equipment with model/level-specific limits; brand alone does not establish fit. Rules and services establish context, not a complete OEM AI workflow; model years and trims remain explicit.
